method: How we verified: the official list comes from Exophase [9], matched 1:1 with the kit; the hidden set comes from Insider-Gaming [5], cross-checked against eGamers [3]; counts come from [1] and [2]; 5 trophies are marked unconfirmed rather than guessed.
note: All ten sources were read on 20 Nov 2026 during study; this builder re-checked the facts against the study notes in-session and wrote every guide in its own words. Numbers in brackets are the citation keys used by every guide step.
